<div class="consulting-lead">
I help biotech and research teams turn sequencing and scientific data into **reproducible pipelines, dependable cloud workflows, and usable data products**. 10+ years across biotech, consulting, NIH, and FDA.
</div>

<div class="consulting-kicker">Four focused offerings</div>

::: {.consulting-grid}

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">01 / WORKFLOWS</div>

### Reproducible bioinformatics pipelines

From a folder of scripts to a workflow your team can rerun, inspect, and hand over.

- **Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq** processing and analysis
- **Antibody repertoire NGS**, including customized nf-core/airrflow
- **Nextflow** with containers and Python/R notebooks

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> a documented, runnable pipeline with handover.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> bulk and single-cell RNA-seq pipelines at FDA; an antibody pipeline for 2B+ sequences.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>Nextflow</span><span>Snakemake</span><span>Python</span><span>R</span><span>Containers</span></div>
:::

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">02 / CLOUD COMPUTE</div>

### Cloud foundations for scientific workloads

Storage and compute sized to your data and budget, on AWS or Azure in your own account.

- **Raw, processed, and results** data organized in cloud object storage
- Pipeline stages matched to **measured** compute needs, with scaling options
- Permissions, logging, and cost visibility

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> a pilot deployment or blueprint, with cost/performance trade-offs.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> AWS S3, EC2, and Snakemake genomics pipeline with analytics across 12,500+ datasets.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>AWS S3</span><span>EC2</span><span>Azure Data Lake Storage</span><span>Nextflow</span></div>
:::

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">03 / DATA PLATFORMS</div>

### Life-sciences data engineering

Scattered files and extracts turned into data your teams can trust.

- Ingestion and transformation into **raw, curated, and analytics-ready** layers, with schema checks
- **Databricks**, SQL, and Python/R notebooks where they add value
- **Azure Data Factory** or AWS services for orchestration

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> data-flow design, reusable code, and quality checks.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> model-ready antibody repertoires at scale; cloud data platforms covering ingestion, security, and monitoring.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>Azure</span><span>AWS</span><span>Databricks</span><span>SQL</span><span>Python</span><span>R</span></div>
:::

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">04 / SCIENTIFIC AI</div>

### Antibody and protein AI prototypes

Test whether protein language models can support a research decision.

- **Embeddings** (such as ESM-2) compared with transparent baselines
- **Fitness and developability** scoring with held-out data and stated limitations
- Reproducible notebooks or batch workflow

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> a proof of concept, evaluation, and go/no-go recommendation. Outputs support research decisions; they do not replace experimental validation.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> zero-shot antibody fitness and developability pipeline, with evaluation and validation design.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>Python</span><span>PyTorch</span><span>MLflow</span><span>Protein language models</span></div>
:::

:::
